html:
Emperor of Ethiopia from 1930 to 1974, the last of the Ethiopian Empire. Born Tafari Makonnen, he was regent from 1916 and was crowned in 1930. He gave Ethiopia its first written constitution in 1931.

When Italy invaded in 1935, he led the resistance, then went into exile. His 1936 speech to the League of Nations in Geneva, asking for help that never came, made him a world figure. He returned in 1941 when British and Ethiopian forces drove the Italians out.

After the war he modernised schools, the army and the state, but kept power in his own hands. He was a leading voice of independent Africa and hosted the founding of the Organisation of African Unity in Addis Ababa in 1963. The Rastafari movement, born in Jamaica, sees him as divine; he granted land to Rastafari settlers in the Shashamane land grant.

A hidden famine, inflation and army unrest brought him down. The military committee known as the Derg deposed him in 1974, and he died in their custody the next year.
